options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

options.name: Chaos Mod Traps
options.doc:
Replaces the regular traps with Chaos Mod effects. Requires Chaos Mod to be installed.

The level is a ceiling: Low only rolls low severity chaos traps, Medium rolls low or medium, and
High rolls all three. Off keeps the regular traps.

options.name: Starting Point
options.doc:
Where your game begins.

Anything past Los Santos requires loading the matching save file that ships with the mod -
the story missions before that point are dropped from the pool entirely.

Note: This option does not affect collectibles. I.e., starting in Badlands and leaving Include
Tags on will keep all tags in the pool.

Must be earlier than your End Goal.

options.name: End Goal
options.doc: What mission you need to complete to finish your game.

choices.label: Are You Going To San Fierro

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Tag Checks
options.doc:
How many of the 100 Los Santos spray tags are location checks - a random set of that size, and
only the chosen ones show blips. 0 disables them.
options.doc_fr: Combien des 100 étiquettes de pulvérisation de Los Santos sont des vérifications de localisation - un ensemble aléatoire de cette taille, et seuls les élus montrent des blips. 0 les désactive.

options.name: Snapshot Checks
options.doc:
How many of the 50 San Fierro snapshots are location checks - a random set of that size, and
only the chosen ones show blips. 0 disables them. Ignored unless San Fierro is in scope.
options.doc_fr: Combien des 50 snapshots San Fierro sont des vérifications de localisation - un ensemble aléatoire de cette taille, et seuls les élus montrent des blips. 0 les désactive. Ignoré à moins que San Fierro n'ait une portée.

options.name: Horseshoe Checks
options.doc:
How many of the 50 Las Venturas horseshoes are location checks - a random set of that size, and
only the chosen ones show blips. 0 disables them. They are gated by the Horseshoes Unlock item
alone, so they are available on every goal.
options.doc_fr: Combien des 50 fers à cheval Las Venturas sont des contrôles de localisation - un ensemble aléatoire de cette taille, et seuls les élus montrent des blips. 0 les désactive. Ils sont bloqués par les Horseshoes Débloquer l'élément seul, donc ils sont disponibles sur tous les buts.

options.name: Oyster Checks
options.doc:
How many of the 50 oysters are location checks - a random set of that size, and only the chosen
ones show blips. 0 disables them. They are gated by the Oysters Unlock item alone, so they are
available on every goal.
options.doc_fr: Combien d'huîtres sur 50 sont des contrôles de localisation - un ensemble aléatoire de cette taille, et seuls les choisis montrent des blips. 0 les désactive. Ils sont bloqués par l'élément Oysters Unlock seul, donc ils sont disponibles sur tous les buts.

options.name: Stunt Jump Checks
options.doc:
How many of the 70 unique stunt jumps are location checks - a random set of that size, and only
the chosen ones show blips. 0 disables them. They are gated by the Stunt Jumps Unlock item
alone, so they are available on every goal.
options.doc_fr: Combien des 70 sauts de cascade uniques sont des vérifications de localisation - un ensemble aléatoire de cette taille, et seuls les élus montrent des blips. 0 les désactive. Ils sont bloqués par l'élément Stunt Jumps Unlock seul, donc ils sont disponibles sur tous les buts.

options.name: School Medals
options.doc:
Which medals will send checks to the multiworld.
E.g. Choosing silver will generate checks for bronze and silver medals.

Off removes all four schools - driving, flying, boat and bike - from the seed.

options.name: Include Exports
options.doc:
How many lists on the San Fierro export board are location checks.

With Include Wang Cars on they come on every goal, gated by that item alone. With it off they
follow the story instead, and are ignored unless San Fierro is in scope.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de listes sur le San Fierro export board sont des vérifications de localisation.

Avec Inclure Wang Cars sur ils viennent sur tous les buts, bloqués par cet article seul. Avec cela, ils suivent l'histoire à la place, et sont ignorés à moins que San Fierro soit dans la portée.

options.name: Include Ammu-Nation Shop
options.doc:
Whether Ammu-Nation purchases are location checks. Buying an item sends the check
instead of giving the vanilla weapon (money is still spent).

options.name: Include Challenges
options.doc: Whether challenges (BMX, NRG-500, Chilliad Races) are included as locations.

options.name: Include Stadium Events
options.doc:
Whether the stadium events (8-Track, Dirt Track, Blood Ring, Kickstart) are included as
locations. 8-Track and Dirt Track are gated behind Max Driving Skill and Max Bike Skill respectively.

options.name: Include Street Races
options.doc:
Whether the 25 street races are included as locations, one per race won.

Turning this on, will add a Street Races Unlock item to the pool which upon receiving creates the blips
at any point in the game.

With it off, there are no race locations, no item, and the races unlock the vanilla way.

options.name: Include Wang Cars
options.doc:
Whether 4 Wang Cars missions are included as checks and unlocked early with a Unlock Wang Cars item.

Unlock Wang Cars also adds Import/Export to logic upon receiving.

With this off, missions are not generated as locations and there is no unlock item.
This setting does not affect Import/Export.

options.name: Include Shooting Range
options.doc:
Whether the four Ammu-Nation shooting range challenges are included as locations, one per weapon
challenge passed: Pistol, Micro Uzi, Shotgun and AK-47.

options.name: Starting Unlock
options.doc:
Whether one randomly chosen unlock item is granted at the start.

Every side activity is gated behind its own item, this hands over one of them - a submission, the tags,
the horseshoes, or the street races. Never the oysters.

options.name: Trap Percentage
options.doc: Percentage of filler items that are traps (flat tires, fat CJ, wanted level, car fire, bad weather).

options.name: Paramedic Checks
options.doc: How many Paramedic levels send a check. 0 removes Paramedic from the seed.
options.doc_fr: Combien de niveaux paramédicaux envoient un chèque. 0 enlève le paramédic de la graine.

options.name: Firefighter Checks
options.doc: How many Firefighter levels send a check. 0 removes Firefighter from the seed.
options.doc_fr: Combien de niveaux de pompiers envoient un chèque. 0 enlève les pompiers de la semence.

options.name: Vigilante Checks
options.doc: How many Vigilante levels send a check. 0 removes Vigilante from the seed.
options.doc_fr: Combien de niveaux Vigilante envoient un chèque. 0 enlève Vigilante de la graine.

options.name: Taxi Checks
options.doc:
How many Taxi fare milestones send a check. Each milestone is 1 fare, so
e.g. 3 sends checks at 1, 2 and 3 fares. 0 removes Taxi from the seed.
options.doc_fr: Combien d'étapes du tarif Taxi envoyer un chèque. Chaque étape est de 1 tarif, par exemple 3 envoie des chèques à 1, 2 et 3 tarifs. 0 enlève Taxi de la semence.

options.name: Burglary Checks
options.doc:
How many Burglary milestones send a check. Each milestone is $1000 stolen,
so e.g. 3 sends checks at $1000, $2000 and $3000. 0 removes Burglary from the seed.
options.doc_fr: Combien d'étapes de cambriolage envoyer un chèque. Chaque étape est de 1 000 $ volé, par exemple, 3 envoie des chèques à 1 000 $, 2 000 $ et 3 000 $. 0 enlève le cambriolage de la graine.

options.name: Trucking Checks
options.doc: How many Trucking levels send a check. 0 removes Trucking from the seed.
options.doc_fr: Combien de niveaux de camion envoie un chèque. 0 enlève le camionnage de la semence.

options.name: Valet Checks
options.doc:
How many Valet milestones send a check. The milestones are at 3, 7, 12, 18
and 25 cars, so e.g. 3 sends checks at 3, 7 and 12 cars. 0 removes Valet from the seed.
options.doc_fr: Combien de jalons de Valet envoyer un chèque. Les étapes sont de 3, 7, 12, 18 et 25 voitures, par exemple, 3 envoie des vérifications à 3, 7 et 12 voitures. 0 enlève Valet de la semence.

options.name: Pimping Checks
options.doc: How many Pimping levels send a check. 0 removes Pimping from the seed.
options.doc_fr: Combien de niveaux Pimping envoient un chèque. 0 enlève le pimping de la graine.

options.name: Quarry Checks
options.doc: How many Quarry missions send a check. 0 removes the Quarry from the seed.
options.doc_fr: Combien de missions de carrière envoient un chèque. 0 enlève la carrière de la graine.

options.name: Courier Checks
options.doc:
How many Courier levels send a check (Roboi's Food Mart, Hippy Shopper, Burger
Shot). 0 turns courier checks off entirely.
options.doc_fr: Combien de niveaux de Courrier envoyer un chèque (Roboi's Food Mart, Hippy Shopper, Burger Shot). 0 tourne les chèques de messagerie entièrement.

options.name: Freight Checks
options.doc:
How many levels of the Brown Streak freight mission send a check. 0 turns the freight off
entirely. Only in seeds that go past Yay Ka-Boom-Boom.
options.doc_fr: Combien de niveaux de la mission Brown Streak envoyer un chèque. 0 éteint entièrement le fret. Seulement dans les graines qui passent devant Yay Ka-Boom-Boom.

options.name: Gang Territory Target %
options.doc:
Percentage of gang territory to retake in Return to Los Santos, sending a check every 5% up
to your target (so 35 sends checks at 5, 10, ... 35%). Rounded DOWN to the nearest 5%, anything
below 5 turns gang territory checks off entirely, same as 0. Only appears on the End of the Line
goal.
